subject: AcmeHealth - Private VPC discovery recap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: John Patel <john.patel@acmehealth.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmehealth.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T15:00:00-07:00
Subject: AcmeHealth - Private VPC discovery recap

Hi John / Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so everyone has the same notes and next steps. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points / drivers
- Data residency & regulatory (HIPAA / patient data) — must keep PHI within US regions and maintain strict audit trails.
- Air-gap / restricted egress requirement for some workloads (legal is evaluating).
- Networking constraints: only outbound via approved proxies, strict firewall rules, no direct public IPs for inference hosts.
- Scale needs: planning for ~400-600 inference requests/sec initially (batching expected), peak bursts up to ~1k req/s.
- Latency target: P95 < 200ms for user-facing features.

What we discussed as potential approaches
- Private VPC deployment (Redwood Private) with customer-managed VPC peering and strict routing rules.
- On-prem/air-gapped option if legal requires no internet egress; we can support an air-gapped bundle and on-prem runtime.
- KMS/HSM integration for key custody and audit logging; support for SOC2 artifacts.

Immediate next steps (action items)
1) Redwood: share networking checklist and architecture blueprint (attached: redwood-private-overview.pdf, networking-checklist.xlsx).
2) Schedule a technical deep dive with Acme infra + our solutions engineering (David) to walk networking/firewall details and sizing.
3) Redwood: provide high-level pricing ranges for Dedicated vs Private/on-prem and a procurement checklist for legal/procurement.
4) Acme: confirm preferred timeline for pilot (you mentioned targeting a Q4 PO) and list any additional compliance docs needed.

If that all looks right, I’ll circulate a proposed time for the technical deep dive next week and include David and Neha on the invite.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0143

Attachment: redwood-private-overview.pdf (summary architecture)
Attachment: networking-checklist.xlsx (networking questions & firewall rules)

Subject: Re: AcmeHealth - Private VPC discovery recap

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A couple quick items from our side:

- Timeline: we are hoping to have procurement wrapped and a PO ready by end of Q4 (latest). Pilot could start earlier if tech checks out.
- Cost: can you provide a ballpark monthly cost range for Private VPC vs an on-prem perpetual license + support? We just need top-line ranges to talk to finance.
- Compliance: please include whoever owns SOC2/compliance artifacts in the next email — our InfoSec will want to review evidence and a data flow diagram.

Also, can we aim for a technical deep dive the week of Aug 17? Prefer mornings PST.

Appreciate it,
John
Director of Infrastructure | Acme Health
john.patel@acmehealth.com

Thanks John — great context. Confirming next steps and a couple of clarifications:

1) Tech deep dive: proposed windows the week of Aug 17, mornings PST. I’ll send a Doodle in a follow-up and target 60-90 minutes so David can walk through the networking checklist and sizing assumptions.
2) Pricing ranges: I’ll send high-level ranges for Private VPC (monthly commit) vs on-prem (license + support) by EOD Wednesday Aug 12 — these will be ranges only until we clarify node sizing and SLAs.
3) Compliance package: attaching our SOC2 summary and a checklist of evidence your InfoSec will likely request — I’ll loop in our security contact if/when you want a live call.

Preliminary questions for the deep dive (please review before the call):
- Can you confirm whether outbound traffic must flow through an existing proxy or if you can support a NAT gateway with restricted IP ranges?
- Do you have internal PKI or do you prefer Redwood-managed certs behind customer KMS?
- Expected peak sequence length / max tokens for typical inference requests (helps sizing and KV cache planning).

Next: I’ll share the Doodle and a short agenda. Thanks again — I’ve attached the two docs from earlier in case they didn’t come through.

Best,
Marissa

Subject: AcmeHealth - prep for technical deep dive (internal)

Neha / David — looping you both in to prep for the Aug 17 deep dive with Acme. Quick internal notes:

- Please review networking-checklist.xlsx (attached). Key items to be ready to discuss: firewall egress rules, proxy/NAT options, allowed IP ranges, and whether we can support no-public-IP topology.
- Sizing: customer mentioned expected baseline 400-600 req/s with bursts to ~1k. Prepare 2 sizing options: (a) VPC Dedicated pool (GPU fleet) and (b) on-prem bundle (estimate nodes: 4x A100 or 8x H100 depending on model/quantization).
- Engineering talking points: KV cache considerations for long-running chat sessions, quantization tradeoffs for on-prem, and fallback policies if air-gap limits updates.
- Compliance docs: list of items to send to Acme InfoSec: SOC2 Type II summary, penetration test report, data flow diagram, retention & deletion policy. I’ll coordinate getting the docs out once we have a meet scheduled.

I’ll schedule the calendar invite after I get availability from Acme — targeting Aug 17/18 mornings PST.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
